Overview

Pension Sonnleitn is a family-run accommodation awarded three stars, located in Kirchdorf in Tirol in the federal state of Tirol. It is situated in the village of Habach at the address Haberberg 18, with the postal code 6382. The official contact details provided are telephone +43 5352 62195, email info@sonnleitn.at and the website https://www.sonnleitn.at/. The house is located on a sun-soaked slope in the surroundings of Kirchdorf in Tirol. The guesthouse is listed in the tourism offerings of the St. Johann in Tirol region in the Kitzbühel Alps and carries a three-star classification.
